---
title: "3 · Open questions"
---

::: milestone
**If you're interested and want to explore further**, have a look at the following questions. Not everything here has a known answer.
:::

## 1 · Does the matcher go quiet?

The director's words drop round by round. What about the matcher? In the pair data, keep only `role == "matcher"` and count their messages per repetition. Do they fade out as the common ground grows, and if so, what does that tell you about who was doing the work?

## 2 · Do crowds invent different names?

Pair-built names got a little weird: *mouse*, *angel praying*. A name for five people has to work for five first-impressions at once. Pull round-6 descriptions for one tangram from the 2-player and the 6-player groups and read them side by side: are crowd names more literal? More *square-triangle-head*? Less *mouse*?

## 3 · Which shapes were hardest?

Some shapes get a short name fast; others stay wordy for rounds. Using the pair data, find each shape's average description length at round 6, and pick out the two or three that stayed longest. How much variability is there among the shapes?
